HexKagune 1.0.40 for Forge 1.20.1 (clients need PlayerAnimator, bendy-lib and Photon). Install on client and server (protocol 50). Testing build.

- **Kagune clash (PvP):** if your M1 lands on a player whose own M1 is on its way back at you, both blows are cancelled, nobody is hurt, you're both thrown apart and an impact wind blows out between you (War, Peace, Kaneki/Ayato swipes, Eto, Furuta).
- **Piercing Salvation aim:** the lance now points where you look; the charge pose twisted Peace's chest up to 26 degrees, swinging the whole lance off to his left.
- **Piercing Salvation stance:** his body turns to face your aim while charging and firing (it could lag your view by up to 50 degrees and drag the lance with it).
- **Peace blade aim:** every aimed Peace blade (Waltz, Horizon, lance) is now aimed from the way his body faces, which is how it is drawn, so it lands where it's sent.
- **Centipede Dominion:** the server's copy of your aim now follows the camera too, so bringing your hidden body along can never snap your view back.
